title: Run of the released writing machine
statement: Let $i$ be a work-tape index, let $w$ be a finite word over an alphabet $\Gamma$, and let $d$ be a configuration whose state is the release entry state. After exactly $|w|+1$ steps, the released writing machine is in state $0$ and tape $i$ contains $w$ on the interval of length $|w|$ starting at its initial head position, with the head advanced by $|w|$ and all other configuration components unchanged. It does not reach that exit state at any earlier time, and through time $|w|+1$ every work-tape head moves by at most $|w|$ from its initial position.
hypotheses_covered: Initial configuration $d$ has the release entry state
